response.notes: Deep building shadow covers the whole approach; markings are read with contrast enhancement. Below y~1250 a bright lattice pattern (a structure or its light pattern) covers x~340-560 and hides the lane lines and kerb on the right, so the upstream right limit is extrapolated. Motor lanes appear to be a left-turn lane (x~271-328) and a right-turn lane (x~330-383); the strip x~395-452 to their right looks like a buffered bicycle lane and is included only because the requested right limit is the kerb. The dashed network centre line (x~333) runs on the lane line between the two target lanes, not on the true centre line, which lies near x~270.
